scientific_integrity: Proof is complete under the explicitly stated finite-field assumptions; computational tests are finite corroboration only.
scientific_limitations: Counts labeled ordered idempotent pairs by both ordered product ranks; it does not classify similarity types or Jordan forms. An equivalent historical enumerative formula could remain unidentified.
source_ids: V. Pop, Journal of Science and Arts 16(3), 225-228 (2016), online 2016-09-30, https://www.josa.ro/docs/josa_2016_3/a_06_Pop.pdf
title: Joint rank distribution for products of two finite-field idempotents
